4 killed, 2 wounded in Turkish strike in Syria’s Qamishli – Asayish

Al-Siyahi street in Qamishli – North Press

QAMISHLI, Syria (North Press) – The Internal Security Forces of North and East Syria (Asayish) said on Saturday evening that four people were killed and two others injured in a Turkish strike in al-Sinaa neighborhood in Qamishli city, northeastern Syria.

In a statement published on its official website, the Asayish said that the preliminary investigation indicated that the mysterious blast in the city was caused by a Turkish drone strike that targeted a car in the al-Sinaa neighborhood in Qamishli.

The attack “killed 4 people, including two children,” the statement added.

The Asayish stated that two other people were critically wounded in the assault and taken to hospitals to receive proper treatment.

The strike also caused significant material damage to the shops and vehicles in the vicinity, according to the statement.

The statement noted that the investigation is still ongoing to identify the victims.

The Asayish statement denounced the international community’s silence regarding the repeated Turkish attacks against civilians in its areas of north and east Syria, noting that they aim at destabilizing the region.

Reporting by Adnan Hamo
